formulas.post_snow_subzero_h: count temperature_c < 0 after the final hour with snowfall_cm > 0

supporting_values.event_name: January 2021 rare summer snowstorm in the Andes

criteria.name: Requested JSON shape
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested five top-level fields and the nested metric groups.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if all metric groups are present but naming or nesting differs.

criteria.name: Snow accumulation ledger
criteria.description: Computes total snowfall, peak day, snowy days, longest snowfall run, maximum depth, and depth-retention ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Give roughly 1 point per correct snow metric cluster, with small rounding differences allowed.

criteria.name: Phase and freezing-level calculations
criteria.description: Computes snowfall-weighted temperature, both freezing-level proxies, and snowfall at or below 1 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Give up to 2 points for the weighted temperature and up to 2 points for the freezing-level and low-temperature snow metrics.

criteria.name: Cold and wind ledger
criteria.description: Computes subzero hours, post-snow subzero hours, freezing-degree hours, peak gust, and minimum wind chill.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points if the cold-duration values are right but wind chill or gust coupling is wrong.

criteria.name: Decision label
criteria.description: Applies all five gates and returns sustained_high_terrain_snow_then_refreeze_wind.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point if the label is directionally right but one gate is omitted.

criteria.name: Rounding, units, and interpretation
criteria.description: Uses the requested precision and keeps the interpretation tied to computed time-series metrics.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for correct values with inconsistent precision or weak unit labeling.

provenance.notes: All values are rebuilt from the local CSX-040 event anchor and hourly/daily weather series.
